Profiles are exact CAD projections. DXF files are preliminary blank profiles; material thickness, preparation and machining remain separate controls.
C3 is a two-foot cantilever assembly. C2.1 fixed-bench strength or foot release must not be transferred to this connection without analysis.
No production tolerance, weld symbol or tightening specification is issued. Confirm actual stock, section corner radii, fit and access before final detail.
